name: The Valeyard
oracle_text:
If an opponent would face a villainous choice, they face that choice an additional time. (They can make the same or different choices.)
While voting, you may vote an additional time.
blocked_sentences: If an opponent would face a villainous choice, they face that choice an additional time
While voting, you may vote an additional time

needs.what: a villainous choice op (701.56: a player chooses one of two printed outcomes) plus a player-wide replacement static that makes an opponent face each villainous choice an additional time (repeating the choice, same or different answer)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No villainous choice op or event exists; choose_mode with chooser is the nearest but has no 'face a villainous choice' identity a static could replace, and no static_effect repeats a choice

needs.what: a council's-dilemma / will-of-the-council voting op where each player votes, plus a static granting you an additional vote while voting
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No vote op exists in reference ops; join_forces and choose_player/choose_mode are not votes and no static_effect adds extra votes
